meetings.title: 2nd Meeting 2025
meetings.summary: In today's meeting, the committee discussed the letter sent by Ministry of Finance and Planning regarding the dissolution of Maldives Integrated Tourism Development Corporation. In this regard South Feydhoo constituency member proposed to ask Ministry of Finance and Planning to send the details of the whole process at the end of the company’s dissolution. This was seconded by Faresmaathodaa constituency member Ashraf Rasheed and was passed unanimously. The committee also decided to write a report including the information obtained by the committee, and to send the report to the main committee.

meetings.summary: During today's meeting, the committee reviewed and discussed the information submitted by companies within its purview. In this regard, as Maldives Integrated Tourism Development Corporation Limited has informed that the government has decided to dissolve the company, therefore the committee decided to send a letter to the Ministry of Finance and Planning to inquire about the reason for the decision to dissolve the company and to check the progress of the dissolution process.

Senior Officer Shifna Ali presided over the selection process of committee's chairperson and vice chairperson. South Feydhoo Constituency Member Ibrahim Didi proposed to elect South Fuvahmulah Constituency Member Ibrahim Hussain as the Chair of the Committee. It was seconded by Faresmaathodaa Constituency Member Ashraf Rasheed. Below are the voting details of the appointment. Then, Thoddoo Constituency Member Hussain Sameer proposed to elect Faresmaathodaa Constituency Member Ashraf Rasheed as the Vice Chair of the Committee. It was seconded by South Feydhoo Constituency Member Ibrahim Didi. Below are the voting details of the appointment. Vote: To elect Faresmaathodaa Constituency Member Ashraf Rasheed as the Vice Chair of the Committee Total number of members: 04 Number of members present: 04 Voted Yes: 04 Voted against 0 Abstain: 0 Required to Pass: 03 Result: Passed Hence, Faresmaathodaa Constituency Member Ashraf Rasheed was elected as the Vice Chair of the Committee. Then, Faresmaathodaa Constituency Member Ashraf Rasheed proposed the committee quorum as 3 members, which was seconded by South Feydhoo Constituency Member Ibrahim Didi.
